summary: Core's credential refusal reaches the operator, forget refusals name the holding operation and test VM, cleanup of a failed test restore succeeds, and the master makes members drop repository records it no longer holds.

guide.reason: The credential-refusal message, the forget refusal text and member record cleanup changed what an operator sees.

api.reason: POST /api/v1/storage/credentials answers 409 with Core's reason when Core refuses the credential (the agent acknowledgement route accepts a failed receipt); new peer route POST /api/v1/pool/backup/retain from the pool master to ready members. Both are authenticated by the existing session and pinned peer channel; retain is idempotent.

roadmap.reason: Fixes found in backup scenario testing inside the current slice.

state.record: pool-backup-repositories.json on the pool master and each member.
state.reason: The master's record is authoritative; members hold no unique state and converge to it. The Controller adds nothing durable.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/controller (broker refusal and resend) and internal/agent (forget refusal text, failed test-restore cleanup releasing its pin, master-driven member retain in the transfer lab). No lab or browser walkthrough was run for this record.
